title: Settings
summaryLanguage: Summary language (ISO code, e.g. en, fr, de; empty = global default)
interfaceLanguageHelp: Language of menus and buttons in this web app. Story summaries use the summary language above.
rssHint: Subscribe to your clustered stories from any RSS reader. The URL carries your session token — treat it like a password.
mailHint: Point at an IMAP folder that receives newsletters. The folder is polled regularly; every sender becomes a feed (visible on the Feeds page) and every article link found in a message is processed like an RSS entry. Messages are never marked as read. The password is stored on the server and never shown again.

mailFound.one: {count} message found — processing now, watch the Activity page.
mailFound.other: {count} messages found — processing now, watch the Activity page.

confirmRemoveInbox: Remove {account}? Newsletter feeds already created are kept.
readerHint: Connect an external RSS reader service (Google Reader API standard: Inoreader, FreshRSS, Miniflux, The Old Reader, BazQux). Articles are ingested into a single virtual feed with original publisher URLs, favicons, and origin titles, and read state syncs bidirectionally. Each sync fetches the newest articles first, up to the chosen number, and stops at articles already imported. The login is tested when you add the account; if it fails, the server probes common endpoints (for example one ending in /api/greader.php) and suggests the right address.
readerArticles: Articles to retrieve on first sync (1–5000, default 200). Only unread articles are retrieved: anything already read in the source app is ignored. Later syncs fetch all new unread articles.
importWindow: Import window in days (blank = server default, 0 = everything)
confirmDeleteReader: Delete {name}? Member articles will stay in the archive.
readerPollDone: Poll completed: {articles} new articles, {synced} read states synced.
proposedHint: The summarizer felt these recurring topics didn't fit any existing category.
confirmDeleteUser: Delete user "{username}"? Their read state is lost.
envLockedTitle: Set via environment variable {name} — change it in your container/launch environment and restart
feedbackHint: Replays logged clustering decisions + your merge/split corrections against candidate thresholds. Suggestions are applied only if you confirm them above.
reportSummary: {decisions} decisions logged · {labeled} labeled corrections · current τ_attach = {tau}
notEnoughData: not enough labeled data for a suggestion
g.llm.title: LLM server
g.llm.hint: External OpenAI-compatible server for summarization + embeddings.
g.vector.title: Vector store
g.vector.hint: Where article/story embeddings live. sqlite_vec needs nothing; qdrant is an external server.
g.readeck.title: Readeck (optional)
g.readeck.hint: Self-hosted read-later archive. Set both to enable "Save to Readeck" on stories.
g.sharing.title: Sharing
g.sharing.hint: Languages offered when sharing a story (comma-separated ISO codes, e.g. en,fr,de). Translation happens on demand via the LLM.
g.chatbot.title: Chatbot
g.chatbot.hint: RAG question-answering over the story archive. Answers are grounded on retrieved story summaries.
g.catsug.title: Category suggestions
g.catsug.hint: When the summarizer feels no taxonomy category fits, it may propose a new one — recurring proposals show up below the Categories card.
g.clustering.title: Clustering
g.clustering.hint: Tune via the feedback report below before changing thresholds.
g.ingestion.title: Ingestion & retention
f.embed_base_url: Embeddings base URL (empty = same as LLM)
f.llm_context_tokens: Model context window (tokens, min 2048 — default 32768; match your LLM model)
f.llm_trace_enabled: Live LLM trace on Activity page (1 = on, 0 = off)
f.feed_disable_after_days: Disable feed after N days of failures
f.headline_min_words: Headline min words (0 = no minimum, max 40)
